'''Nebula Eleven''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the eleventh member of [[Nebula Flight]], a part of the [[Corellian Home Fleet|Corellian defense fleet]] that fought for the [[Five Worlds]]. [[Gorvan Peel]] flew as Nebula Eleven during the [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal" />
